baseImage.boundary: The builder must bind its private local base alias to this exact image ID. Application bytes, embedded UI, PostgreSQL clients and the intro helper are inherited; the selected media toolchain changes.

apt.boundary: The extension inherits the base image's fixed Debian and security snapshots. Normal APT signature and package-hash verification remains enabled. Actual resolved versions and driver hashes belong to each built image. Host firmware and the kernel driver are not installed by this recipe.

mediaToolchain.boundary: The complete native v3 prefix and matching installed libplacebo headers are captured as build inputs. Rebuild only FFmpeg/ffprobe from verified 9.0.1 source with strict Dolby Vision, decoder-wakeup and copy-timestamp-progress patches; preserve the input private libraries unchanged and retain their original metadata separately. Final executable digests are generated by the build and are not the v3 input digests. Native v3 acceptance is background evidence, not acceptance of this new image.

runtime.deviceClass: one explicitly selected AMD DRM render node
runtime.boundary: Preserve the selected render node's basename and numeric device identity inside the container. Add its numeric group ID as a supplementary group. The host must supply an operational amdgpu driver and readable sysfs device/vendor identity. Device access and compiled interfaces do not prove media execution.

boundary: This recipe is in progress. Actual archive loading, nonroot container GPU access, media execution, exact fallback and resource closure require separate recorded verification. It does not claim all AMD adapters, arbitrary codecs, Intel/NVIDIA support, public distribution licensing or registry publication.
